title: hibiscus preslii
intro: Hibiscus preslii, commonly known as the Hawaiian hibiscus or orange hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family. It is native to Hawaii and is known for its vibrant orange flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hibiscus preslii include its potential to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and other polyphenolic compounds that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
